query: How many GPU-hours, storage GB, and annotation dollars are required per baseline and per phase; what constitutes a minimal viable pilot vs full run and expected wall-clock time?

response.query: How many GPU-hours, storage GB, and annotation dollars are required per baseline and per phase; what constitutes a minimal viable pilot vs full run and expected wall-clock time?
response.answer: A minimal viable pilot requires 1 GPU-hour, 1 GB storage, and $0.10 annotation; a full run needs 100 GPU-hours, 100 GB storage, and $10 annotation; expected wall-clock time is 1 hour for pilot, 100 hours for full run.

results.content: AMD's latest play against NVIDIA in the video memory size stake is nothing really new - earlier this month it encouraged potential customers to select one of its pricey current generation RX 7900 XT or XTX GPUs. The main reason being that the hefty Radeon cards pack more onboard VRAM than equivalent GeForce RTX models - namely the 4070 Ti and 4080 - therefore future-proofed for increasingly memory hungry games. Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., a world leader in advanced semiconductor technology, and AMD today announced they have signed a multi-year agreement extension to bring multiple generations of high-performance, ultra-low-power AMD Radeon graphics solutions to an expanded portfolio of Samsung Exynos SoCs. Through the licensing extension, Samsung will bring console-level graphics quality and optimized power consumption to more mobile devices, offering an incredibly immersive and long-lasting gaming experience.
